name: atmik-inventory-console
description: Atmik Inventory Console — MERN inventory CRUD & barcode management

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.postinstall: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c cyan,magenta "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix server run typecheck && npm --prefix client run typecheck
scripts.lint: npm --prefix server run lint && npm --prefix client run lint
